answer: Splitting into 5 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded yarrow account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The ledge explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the willow binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Slashing removes 37 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
